title: Ancient Night Sky
description: Changes the sky color to a very dark blue in version rd-132211.
body:
# Ancient Night Sky
### About
This is a simple mod that changes the color of the sky to a very dark blue in version rd-132211. Compatibility with other mods for this version isn't great because this mod overwrites the main class; it does work with my other mod [Ancient Planks](https://modrinth.com/mod/ancient-planks). Enabling or disabling this mod will NOT break or corrupt your levels.
### Installation
This mod is distributed as a zip file, and it can be installed as a jar mod. This mod does not require any mod loader to be installed. This installation guide is only for the Prism Launcher and MultiMC. The Official Minecraft Launcher is not recommended.

![Installation Image Example 1](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/65e33bf5f83cd79ca16d6e2e460461474e92f504.png)
Create a new instance. Tick the Alphas box and scroll all the way down to select version rd-132211. After the instance is created, right click it and press Edit.

![Installation Image Example 2](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/aefcdbc574a625be1e5c9a8a208be5d627d8ad6f.png)
Select the Version tab on the left. Click Add to Minecraft.jar on the right, and then select the downloaded mod. The Ancient Night Sky mod should appear in the versions list, and pressing launch will start the game with the mod enabled.
